title: Wonderful experience at Park Guell
text:
We had a wonderful experience and gained so much knowledge from our tour guide Andres! 
To understand the history, vision of the architect and information about the nature planted allowed us to appreciate the full extent of the park.

title: Experimental and informative

author: 409tamars

title: An Excellent tour
text:
The tour was really fun and informative, Andres is very friendly, he has a lot of interesting information, explains everything and answers every question, and most importantly he is enthusiastic and passionate about what he does. 
I highly recommend it.
author: ragad117

title: Andres - gwell park guide
text: Andres was an excellent instructor and tour guide! He spoke fluent English and explained everything with great enthusiasm, passion, and attention to detail. We were a group of four and had a fantastic time exploring the park with him. His knowledge and engaging personality made the entire experience enjoyable. Highly recommended!
author: Escape37119906550

title: Knowledgeable and experienced guide
text: Stephanie is an extremely experienced and knowledgeable guide. From instructions on meeting to explaining the history and architectural design of the park she was very clear and concise. Took her time with us to explain everything and was very patient as we had an infant with us which suited our pace. Didn’t hesitate to help us with the stroller, pictures etc. I would highly recommend Stephanie as a guide to anyone who is keen to explore Park Guell.
author: X8571BVjoelg

title: Amazing! Highly recommend
text: My husband, daughter, and I did the Parc Guell tour with Stephanie and had the best time! Our daughter was 11 months old and Stephanie worked with us to make it the best experience possible visiting specific sites as needed and taking breaks depending on our daughters schedule. Stephanie was very knowledgeable about the parc, history, and architecture. We were truly very impressed and pleased with our tour. It was by far our favorite when visiting Spain, thanks in large to our guide. She also provides us helpful tips and suggestions for other places to tour and visit while we were still in Spa
author: jacquelynnj2023
